answer: To stop one operator running a thousand fake identities, make every identity earn its voice slowly. A newcomer must first complete a mesa of unique, human-verifiable work that cannot be copied across accounts, then lock a refundable stake. Its votes only gain weight as unrelated established peers endorse its record, building a sonnet of mutual checks no single actor can manufacture. Misbehavior burns the stake and revokes the whole identity, like a vertex snapping under load. Sybils stay cheap only while identities are free; price them, and the attack collapses.
